candidates.raw_title: Alteogen: Keytruda SC (ALT-B4) composition patent registered at EPO, valid to 2040 +SPC
candidates.gate_e: Directly strengthens the IP moat behind ALT-B4/Keytruda SC, one of the two head-to-head SC-checkpoint-inhibitor platforms this tracker exists to compare (vs. ENHANZE/Tecentriq Hybreza).

candidates.raw_title: Roche/Genentech: NCT07503340, Phase 2 pediatric SC ocrelizumab (Ocrevus) PK/safety study, ages 10-<18 RRMS
candidates.gate_e: A pediatric label-extension trial for the already-tracked ENHANZE marketed product Ocrevus Zunovo; determines whether the ENHANZE installed base keeps expanding into new patient populations.

candidates.raw_title: Roche/Genentech: NCT07667322 'OCARINA 3', Phase 1b study of a NEW subcutaneous formulation of ocrelizumab (mechanism not disclosed)
candidates.gate_e: A next-generation SC ocrelizumab formulation distinct from the marketed ENHANZE product -- exactly the kind of pipeline signal that determines whether ENHANZE's installed base is durable or being superseded.
